label: United States: federal standard (FTC Cooling-Off Rule)
summary: The Federal Trade Commission's Rule Concerning Cooling-Off Period for Sales Made at Homes or at Certain Other Locations, 16 CFR Part 429: three business days to cancel, the statement beside the buyer's signature, and the Notice of Cancellation in duplicate. The default for a business in the United States. A state pack for the job's state, when there is one, is layered on top of it.
not_legal_advice: This pack is a starting point drawn from public law, not legal advice. Have your own lawyer review it, and your agreement template, before any customer signs.

sources.what: 16 CFR 429.1 (the statement and the Notice of Cancellation text)
16 CFR Part 429 as last amended at 80 FR 1332 (effective 2015-03-13)
